title: Desert Treasure
start: Talk to Asgarnia Smith, the archaeologist who is exploring the Bedabin Camp south-west of the Shantay Pass.

ironman.t: This is not required if you obtain the magic logs as a drop instead.

items.t: Alternatively, chocolate cake, chocolate bar, cooking apple, or pineapple pizza
Face mask (can be replaced by masked earmuffs, a slayer helmet, a full slayer helmet, or a gas mask)
Up to 100 lockpicks (the lower your Thieving level, the more lockpicks you may require), hair clips, or a master thief's lockpick (which has no chance of breaking)
Ice gloves or another method to defeat Fareed
Silver bar (metal bank will not work)
Climbing boots for the Death Plateau Troll shortcut (or Trollheim Teleport or Trollheim tablet)
Spiked boots for the Ice Path segment (made by bringing Dunstan an iron bar and climbing boots; rock climbing boots will not work)

recommended.t: 47 Agility (to be able to pass certain obstacles on the way to Trollheim)
50 Mining (to obtain the ice gloves for the smoke diamond)
A higher Thieving Thieving level is recommended for a higher chance of success
Runes for casting your best fire and water spells if using Magic
Activated Burthorpe, Canifis, Draynor and Port Sarim lodestone
Skills necklace for fast teleport to Rasolo.
Finished In Search of the Myreque and Eadgar's Ruse for faster transportation
Finished As a First Resort or have unlocked the tier 1 Spa in the Anachronia base camp for access to the salt-water spring, which can be useful for obtaining the Ice and Smoke diamonds
Single-click teleports (e.g. ectophial, or a teleport tablet) for escaping fights that turn for the worse
A charged druid pouch or an ouroboros pouch
Several energy/super energy potions or explorer's ring, prayer potions and restore potions
An enchanted broomstick, Bandit Camp Teleports, Archaeology journal and/or a Dig Site pendant for quicker teleports to the desert and the Exam Centre

kills.t: Stranger (level 81; optional, only encounter if you hold too many Diamonds of Azzanadra for too long)

rewards.t: You can now also pray either at the pyramid altar or the elven grimoire in Prifddinas (after completing Plague's End) and change between the standard and Ancient Magicks spellbooks. You can also enter the altar room by accessing the back-door of the pyramid. Changing spellbooks at the altar will drain your prayer to 0.
Ring of visibility (can be re-obtained from Rasolo for free)
Access to the Smoke Dungeon via the well entrance
Also requires completion of the quest The Giant Dwarf
The Bandit Camp lodestone is now automatically unlocked upon completion
Ability to wield an ancient staff, and buy one from Eblis for 80,000 coins

steps.t: Talk to Asgarnia Smith for some etchings. He is in the Bedabin Camp south-west of the Shantay Pass. [Chat: 2 Do you have any quests? › Accept]
p: The Archaeologist in the Bedabin Camp.

steps.t: Talk to Terry Balando in the Exam Centre. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Desert Treasure quest.]

sub.t: If he offers you a Codex Ultimatus, refuse it or talk to him again.

steps.t: Talk to him again for the Translation. [Chat: 1 Ask about the Desert Treasure quest.]
Return to Asgarnia Smith with the book. [Chat: 2 Don't read book]
Talk to Asgarnia again and offer to help him. [Chat: 1 Help him]
Run south to the Bandit Camp.

sub.t: If you're wearing any Zamorak or Saradomin equipment, bandits become aggressive.

steps.t: Talk to the bartender at the pub for a Bandit's brew. [Chat: 2 Buy a drink › 1 Buy a beer]
Talk to the bartender again. [Chat: 2 I heard about four diamonds...]

Talk to Eblis, by or in the eastern-most building of the Bandit Camp. [Chat: 2 Ask about Desert Treasure › 4 Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra › 1 Yes › 1 Yes, I will go get those for you.] (if the first chat option is not 'Ask about Archaeology' [Chat: 4 Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra › 1 Yes › 1 Yes, I will go get those for you.])

sub.t: He will not speak to you if you're wearing any Zamorak or Saradomin equipment.

steps.t: Use all the items on Eblis, then talk to him again. [Chat: 2 Ask about Desert Treasure]
Run south-east, and talk to Eblis by the Bandit Camp lodestone. [Chat: 2 Ask about Desert Treasure]
Retrieving the four diamonds can be done in any order.
:Jump to §Blood diamond
:Jump to §Ice diamond
:Jump to §Smoke diamond
:Jump to §Shadow diamond
Enter the pub in Canifis. After a short cutscene, talk to Malak. [Chat: 5 I am looking for a special Diamond... › 1 Yes › 3 How can I kill Dessous? › 3 Actually, I don't need to know anything.]
Take a silver bar and talk to Ruantun in the Draynor Sewers for a Silver pot.
Take the pot to the High Priest on Entrana for a Blessed pot.
Talk to Malak in Canifis for a blood-filled Blessed pot (this deals 50 damage).
Crush the garlic, use the garlic powder on the blessed pot, then add spice to get a completed Blessed pot.
Prepare for a level 84 boss fight. If you die, you will have to re-do the previous step.

sub.t: Note: It is recommended to bank your cake or chocolate bar, as a ghast may turn it into rotten food on the journey.

steps.t: Run south-east to the Graveyard (map pictured right).
Use the pot on the tomb, then kill Dessous. Alternating between praying Protect from Melee and Protect from Magic every tick makes Dessous unable to attack.
Return to Canifis.
Speak to Malak to receive the Blood diamond.
Bank the blood diamond immediately. While holding the blood diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.
Prepare for combat by getting plenty of food, a few super restore and super energy potions (even at max combat). Also grab a cake or a chocolate bar if not already in your inventory.

sub.t: Get runes and a magic weapon for fire spells if using Magic. Only fire spells will work if using Magic on Kamil.

steps.t: If you don't have spiked boots, get them first from Dunstan in Burthorpe (requires an iron bar).
If you used your climbing boots to get the spiked boots, then get a new pair of climbing boots from Freda.
Consider using the Endurance relic power in place of energy potions to keep your run energy up.
Travel to Trollheim using Trollheim Teleport.

sub.t: Otherwise, take the path from the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or the Death Plateau to Troll Stronghold with climbing boots.

steps.t: Take the path that leads to the snow area north-west of Troll Stronghold.
Talk to the troll child a few squares west of the ice gate.
Use a cake or a chocolate bar on him. Talk again to help him. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Enable Protect from Melee, and head east through the ice gate.
Kill 5 trolls, then travel through the cave entrance to your east and keep running.
Kill Kamil when he appears.
After you kill Kamil once, continue the path to the north and walk to the ice ledge. You can use Surge and Dive.
Equip your spiked boots and climb the path to the top.
Pass through the ice gate and across the bridge.
Break the two ice blocks at the top (by casting a fire spell or choosing the "smash-ice" option).
Talk to the trolls, the child will give you the Ice diamond.
Bank the ice diamond immediately. While holding the ice diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.
Prepare for combat by bringing plenty of food, few super energy potions, melee gear, or water spells if using magic, or ice arrows if using ranged.
Travel to Pollnivneach.
With your face mask and ice gloves equipped enter the Smoke Dungeon.

sub.t: If Smoking Kills is complete the dungeon can be entered from the Pollnivneach well and through the dark stairs to the west.
Otherwise the player can enter the smokey well which is located west of Pollnivneach.
Killing a dust devil completes the achievement Drafty in Here.

steps.t: Light the four standing torches, 1 in each corner of the dungeon. This part is timed and torches will go out if you are not fast enough.
Consider using the Endurance relic power in place of energy potions to keep your run energy up.
Open the burnt chest in the middle of the dungeon to receive a Warm key.

sub.t: Each torch will remain lit for exactly 5 minutes, and you will receive a game message when each one dies out. You will be unable to open the chest if any of the torches have gone out, even if you have lit all 4 torches before attempting.

steps.t: With the warm key, open the gate on the eastern side of the dungeon.
Defeat Fareed for the Smoke diamond.

sub.t: You must use melee, ranged, necromancy, or water spells.
You must wear ice gloves to wield a main-hand weapon while fighting him, including staves and bows. Off-hand weapons are not restricted.
While ranged weapons are effective on Fareed, any ammunition used by auto-attacks besides ice arrows will drop beneath him as ashes, bypassing the ammo-saving effect of Ava's accumulator.

steps.t: Bank the smoke diamond immediately. While holding the smoke diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.
Travel to Rasolo (north-west from Ardougne lodestone; see the map to the right). [Chat: 3 Ask about the Diamonds of Azzanadra › 1 Yes]
Return to the desert Bandit Camp.
Unlock the secure chest in the southern-most tent. You might consume between 10 to 100 lockpicks.

sub.t: Hair clips are very useful here, as you can reclaim them from Merlin for free.
You can steal from the level 54 Bandits around the camp to get lock picks and antipoison.
Master thief's lockpick also works and will never break.
Five finger discount upgrades help.

steps.t: Prepare for combat before returning the cross to Rasolo who will give you a ring of visibility.
Equip the ring, run into the nearby triangular fenced area and climb down the ladder. You may equip any other ring now as this was only required to see the invisible ladder.
Run east to Damis and kill him in both phases for the Shadow diamond. See the map below for the path to take.

sub.t: If Damis despawns, run a small distance back from where you came, then run back.

steps.t: Bank the shadow diamond immediately. While holding the shadow diamond, a stranger capable of dealing over 5,000 damage per attack can spawn at any time.
Make sure your weight is less than 5kg or you'll keep failing traps.

sub.t: Boots of lightness and any other weight reducing equipment helps.

p: A map of the pyramid's interior

steps.t: Return to the Bandit Camp, and head directly south of Eblis to the pyramid.
Use the diamonds on the obelisks surrounding the pyramid.

sub.t: Blood diamond in the north-west obelisk.
Shadow diamond in the south-west obelisk.
Ice diamond in the south-east obelisk.
Smoke diamond in the north-east obelisk.

steps.t: Climb down the ladder at the top of the pyramid.
p: Safespotting Damis in his second form.

steps.t: Run through the pyramid using the map. Don't stand still, or you may be transported back to the start.

sub.t: There's a possibility that scarabs spawn in Azzanadra's room so bring a weapon, antipoison, and some more food just in case.

p: Malak drains your blood into the pot.
Ruantun living in the Draynor Sewers.
The chest containing the Gilded cross.

steps.t: Talk to Azzanadra.
Quest complete!

p: Using a dwarf multicannon to damage Dessous
A torch in the smoke dungeon.
Fareed; the guardian of the smoke diamond.
